LESSON: WRITING 9.5.1 CREATIVE WRITING: NARRATIVE COMPOSITIONS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.5: Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you make your composition writing better? 2. How can you make a composition memorable?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and Imagination: Learner develops the skill of making connections as they look at problems in a new way and undertake the

task of narrative writing and sharing.

● Self-Efficacy: Learner develops the skill of effective communication as learners pay attention to detail, plan a narrative composition,

and tell a chain story.

Values:
● Social justice: is enhanced as learners write a narrative composition on historical and current heroes and heroines which expose them to

issues like colonisation.

Link to other Subjects

The learner relates the skill of composing and performance to their learning in Creative Arts.

The learner relates narrative writing skill to other learning areas such as Kiswahili and Religious Education.
